GRADE R–7 · ENGLISH & SEPEDI

Learning worksheets

Each grade has 20 supplementary activities. Select a subject for a smaller pack. Sepedi translations await fluent teacher review.

Files download as HTML. Open the downloaded file and choose “Print / Save as PDF”. No account or learner details are required.

How to print or save a worksheet
  1. Choose the grade, language and subject.
  2. Download the worksheet; download answers separately if needed.
  3. Open the file in a browser and select Print / Save as PDF.
  4. Choose your printer or the browser’s PDF option.
